Evaluators rated each generated sentence on a 5‑point Likert scale for fluency, coverage (fact correctness) and hallucination (absence of extra information).

The evaluation has been done on 100 samples for 7 languages on a 5-point Likert scale per metric. Fluency checks for coherence and grammar correctness of generated output. Coverage verifies if most facts are captured in the sentence correctly. Absence of extra information verifies if the model does not generate any hallucinated information.
